#{cashHeadKind}, #{settlementRoute}, #{sourceContractType}, #{sourceContractId}, #{commercialContextType}, #{commercialContextId}, #{beneficiaryRole}, #{beneficiaryId}, #{serviceUnit}, #{topicId}, #{coopOrderId}, #{merchantId}, #{shareMode}, #{shareRate}, #{fixedFee}, #{verifiedHeads}, #{verifiedSales}, #{amount}, #{verifiedRegIds}, #{status}, #{payableTime}, #{settleTime}, #{payoutTime}, #{createTime}, #{delFlag}, #{lineType}, #{payeeType},
mapper.select: select count(1) from coop_settlement where coop_order_id = #{coopOrderId} and del_flag = 0

for update
mapper.sql: select s.id, s.topic_id, s.payee_type, s.line_type, s.amount, s.status, s.payable_time, s.settle_time, s.payout_time, case when a.settlement_id is null then 0 else a.executed_amount end as executed_adjustment_amount, paid.change_balance as actual_paid_amount, paid.create_time as actual_payout_time, t.name as topic_name

from coop_settlement s left join cms_topic t on t.id = s.topic_id left join ( select settlement_id, case when count(*) = count(amount) then sum(amount) else null end as executed_amount from coop_settlement_adjustment where status = 'EXECUTED' group by settlement_id ) a on a.settlement_id = s.id left join ums_member_balance_detail paid on paid.coop_settlement_payout_id = s.id and paid.member_id = s.merchant_id and paid.change_type = 1 and paid.del_flag = 0
mapper.select:
select s.*, case when a.settlement_id is null then 0 else a.executed_amount end as executed_adjustment_amount, paid.change_balance as actual_paid_amount, paid.create_time as actual_payout_time, t.name as topic_name
where s.del_flag = 0 and s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by s.create_time desc, s.id desc
where s.del_flag = 0 and s.beneficiary_role = #{role} and s.beneficiary_id = #{beneficiaryId} order by s.create_time desc, s.id desc
mapper.sql: from settlement_detail adj join refund_application ra on ra.id = adj.source_id and ra.source_type = 'registration' join cms_registration rr on rr.id = ra.source_id where adj.source_type = 'refund' and adj.status = 1 and rr.owner_type = 2 and rr.owner_id = a.id
mapper.select: select a.id as activity_id, a.name as activity_name, a.start_date, sum(pay.change_balance) + (select coalesce(sum(adj.settlement_amount), 0) and adj.receiver_type = 'merchant') as net_amount, (select coalesce(sum(fee.change_balance), 0) from ums_member_balance_detail fee where fee.event_type = 7 and fee.change_type = 1 and fee.del_flag = 0 and fee.event_id = a.id) + (select coalesce(sum(adj.settlement_amount), 0) and adj.receiver_type = 'platform') as platform_amount, (select coalesce(sum(mf.change_balance), 0) from ums_member_balance_detail mf where mf.event_type = 95 and mf.change_type = 1 and mf.del_flag = 0 and mf.event_id = a.id) + (select coalesce(sum(adj.settlement_amount), 0) and adj.receiver_type = 'coop_merchant') as merchant_fee_amount, min(pay.member_id) as payee_min_member_id, max(pay.member_id) as payee_max_member_id, max(pay.create_time) as settled_at from cms_activity a join ums_member_balance_detail pay on pay.event_id = a.id and pay.event_type = 3 and pay.change_type = 1 and pay.del_flag = 0 where a.club_id = #{clubId} group by a.id, a.name, a.start_date order by max(pay.create_time) desc, a.id desc

select a.id as activity_id, a.name as activity_name, a.start_date, sum(pay.change_balance) + (select coalesce(sum(adj.settlement_amount), 0) and adj.receiver_type = 'merchant' and adj.receiver_id = #{memberId}) as net_amount, min(pay.member_id) as payee_min_member_id, max(pay.member_id) as payee_max_member_id from cms_activity a join ums_member_balance_detail pay on pay.event_id = a.id and pay.event_type = 3 and pay.change_type = 1 and pay.del_flag = 0 and pay.member_id = #{memberId} where a.club_id = #{clubId} group by a.id, a.name, a.start_date order by max(pay.create_time) desc, a.id desc

select distinct c.id as "clubId", c.name as "name" from club c join ( select beneficiary_id as club_id from coop_settlement where del_flag = 0 and beneficiary_role = 'CLUB' and merchant_id = #{memberId} union select t.club_id from coop_settlement s join cms_topic t on t.id = s.topic_id where s.del_flag = 0 and s.merchant_id = #{memberId} and s.beneficiary_role is null and s.payee_type = 'initiator' and s.line_type in ('INITIATOR_MARGIN', 'INITIATOR_GUARANTEE') union select a.club_id from cms_activity a join ums_member_balance_detail pay on pay.event_id = a.id and pay.event_type = 3 and pay.change_type = 1 and pay.del_flag = 0 and pay.member_id = #{memberId} ) earned on earned.club_id = c.id order by c.id desc
where s.del_flag = 0 and s.topic_id = #{topicId} order by s.create_time desc, s.id desc
mapper.update: update coop_settlement set status = 2 where del_flag = 0 and status = 0 and topic_id = #{topicId}
